item.title: Yankees to retire CC Sabathia’s No. 52, unveil plaque in Monument Park in 2026
item.description: The Yankees are adding another number to Monument Park.

item.title: Lamar Odom checks out of rehab following DUI arrest
item.description: Odom’s rehab stint was not court-mandated, though he said he chose to get help out of concern that his marijuana use could lead to a relapse on heavier drugs.

item.title: Man, 40, convicted of racist attacks and stalking in Manhattan
item.description: A political gadfly accused in a series of racist attacks, including punching TikTok influencer Halley Kate McGookin in the face, and for stalking a Jewish couple in Manhattan has been found guilty by a judge, according to Manhattan District Attorney Alvin Bragg. item.title: Harvey Weinstein joins Diddy and Luigi Mangione on defense lawyer Marc Agnifilo’s star-studded client roster
item.description: The disgraced film producer is swapping out Arthur Aidala, who's represented the Miramax founder since an avalanche of sexual assault allegations spurred his steep fall from grace and turbocharged the #MeToo movement almost a decade ago.

item.title: Trump lashes out at ‘criminal’ Robert De Niro, suggests he leave the U.S.
item.description: After Robert De Niro headlined an event to counter the State of the Union, President Trump ranted that the "criminal" should leave the U.S. like Rosie O'Donnell.

item.title: Woman reported missing in New Haven last year arrested for bank fraud in California
item.description: A woman who was reported missing in New Haven last year has been arrested in California along with two New Yorkers and charged with identity theft and bank fraud.

item.title: Woman’s boots set on fire by two men after she refused kiss in Manhattan
item.description: A woman's boots were destroyed after two men — including one wearing a "Make America Great Again" hat — lit them on fire while spewing racist remarks after she refused to kiss one of them in Manhattan, cops said Wednesday.

item.title: St. John’s suffers historic 72-40 loss to UConn, loses lead in Big East
item.description: The St. John’s win streak ended in extreme fashion. And the Red Storm’s path to a Big East championship just got more complicated.

item.title: Yankees bringing in Randal Grichuk as non-roster invitee
item.description: The Yankees have finally found an outfielder who hits from the right side.
